dataset_name: CDC NHANES Depression Screening & Health Lifestyle Dataset
source: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) - National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey (NHANES) 2005-2018
target_definition: Patient Health Questionnaire-9 (PHQ-9) depression screener score threshold >= 10 indicates Depressed; score < 10 indicates Not Depressed (Kroenke et al., 2001).
description: Karakteristik demografi, riwayat tidur, aktivitas fisik, status kerja, fungsi kognitif, dan pengukuran fisiologis dari survei kesehatan nasional CDC NHANES.
